planning_assumptions: Observed v5 cost USD 0.1967478 / 12 eligible B+C pairs, multiplied by the planned pair/variant count. This extrapolation is not a guaranteed forecast.
bound_assumptions: Every request at input byte limit plus 4096 overhead tokens and maximum output tokens; peak/cache-miss prices. No automatic network retries.

pricing.assumption: Peak rates, all input charged as cache miss; ignore all discounts.
